import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/berni/.codex/worktrees/e181/labs')
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/encode-pointer-evidence')
command=['deno','bench','--no-lock','--json','packages/memory/test/v2-path.bench.ts','packages/dashboard/machine-calibration.bench.ts']
runs=[]
for pair in range(5):
 for side in (['baseline','fixed'] if pair%2==0 else ['fixed','baseline']):
  cwd='/tmp/encode-pointer-baseline' if side=='baseline' else str(root)
  meta=dict(pair=pair+1,side=side,loadBefore=os.getloadavg(),started=time.time())
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  meta.update(loadAfter=os.getloadavg(),finished=time.time(),report=json.loads(result.stdout),stderr=result.stderr)
  runs.append(meta)
  (out/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,runs=runs),indent=2)+'\n')
  print(pair+1,side,[(b['name'],round(b['results'][0]['ok']['p75']/1e3,2)) for b in meta['report']['benches']],flush=True)
drivers.paired.py:
import json,subprocess,os,time,pathlib
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/encode-pointer-evidence')
runs=[]
for i in range(5):
 meta=dict(run=i+1,loadBefore=os.getloadavg(),started=time.time())
 result=subprocess.run(['deno','run','--no-lock','-A',str(out/'paired.ts')],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 meta.update(loadAfter=os.getloadavg(),finished=time.time(),results=json.loads(result.stdout))
 runs.append(meta)
 (out/'paired.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('paired process',i+1,'complete',flush=True)
